purpose: Frozen identical frame set for v2-L FP vs recalibrated INT8 vs TD01 evaluation; detector-independent uniform source-frame sampling.

sampling.selection_method: decoded source-frame index; monotonically increasing; no detector-dependent filtering or manual selection

extraction.version: ffmpeg version 6.1.1-3ubuntu5+git20240717.8164ff7d~noble Copyright (c) 2000-2023 the FFmpeg developers
extraction.algorithm: Decode source once; FFmpeg select filter emits exactly the listed decoded frame indices in source order; PNG files are numbered by sample index starting at 0.

freeze.policy: Dataset contents are read-only: PNG files and manifest mode 0444; frames directory and dataset root mode 0555.
freeze.scope: The manifest and all 300 extracted PNG files are the immutable evaluation input set.
